title: Pumpkin Fritters with Coriander Pesto
subtitle: served on tortillas with salad and tahini
description: Light, fluffy pumpkin and chickpea flour balls, similar to falafel, made airy with whipped egg whites and served on tortillas with chopped salad and tahini or yoghurt.

steps.text: Boil the peeled pumpkin in plenty of water for 30 minutes until soft. Drain and mash to a puree.
Make the pesto by pulsing the coriander, onion, garlic, olive oil and a little salt in a blender or food processor into an even paste.
Whip the egg whites to a soft foam in a blender or with a hand mixer. Mix with the pesto, pumpkin puree, chickpea flour, oats and spices until even. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes until the mixture firms up enough to shape.
Heat oil for shallow frying in a frying pan.

With wet or oiled hands, shape flat balls 4 to 5 cm wide and fry for 3 minutes each side until golden. For an oven version, brush with olive oil and bake at 220°C for 10 to 15 minutes on a tray lined with baking paper.
Serve on tortillas with salad and tahini and/or yoghurt.
